contexts.text: Everyone (in Heaven) is as it were a centre to all the rest.
Wherever the Lord is, there is the centre...
The heavenly form is of such a nature, that everyone is a kind of centre, thus a centre of communications, and therefore of happiness from all... AC 2872. AC 3633:end.
He now proceeds from the good and truth which he believes and perceives as from a centre to the circumferences... Thenceforth as from new centres he produces new circumferences, and so on.
Everyone (in Heaven) is the centre of all the influxes...
To the Lord as a Sun and to the Centre there, all things have reference...
The Lord is the Centre of all things...

(The sensuous things) which agree (with truths) are as it were in the centres, and those which disagree are in the circumferences; those which are in the centres are as it were lifted up towards Heaven, and those which are in the circumferences as it were hang downwards; those which are in the centres receive light through the Rational, and when presented to view in the other life appear like little stars which sparkle and throw out light on every side even to the circumferences... But when the Rational is subjected to sensuous things, the contrary happens, for then falsities are in the midst, or in the centre, and truths are in the circumferences; those things which are in the centre are in a sort of lumen there...
Evils are then separated, and are cast out from the centre... to the circumferences... DP 79.
The best is in the midst, that is, in the centre, or inmost...
Those things which are directly under the sight are in the midst, that is, in the centre... AC 6084:2.
The inmost thing which flows in keeps the centre there...
The Lord is the Centre of the looking of all (in Heaven).

Elevation by the Lord... is like a pressing towards the centre of gravity; the centre is where the Lord is in His Sun; towards this are the heads of the Angels elevated, but the feet of the infernals...
The Lord is the common Centre of Heaven. HH 124. HH 142. HH 430:end. NJHD 307, References.
To look below is to look backwards from the Lord to the opposite centre, to which look and tend all things of Hell.
(Love to the neighbour beginning from self as a centre, and from the Lord as a centre, compared.)
The best of the English nation are in the centre of all Christians. The reason they are in the centre, is that they have an interior intellectual light. TCR 807.

With the evil, evils with falsities are as it were in the centre, and goods with truths in the circumferences; but with the good, goods with truths are in the centre, and evils with falsities in the circumferences; and in both cases, the things which are of the centre spread themselves out to the circumferences; as heat does from fire in the centre, and as cold does from frost in the centre. Thus with the evil, the goods in the circumferences are defiled by the evils of the centre; and with the good, the evils in the circumferences are made mild by the goods of the centre.
Whether the centre is from the expanse, or the expanse from the centre. Explained. TCR 35:7.
That those who are inmost are as it were bases and multiplied centres, like the stars in the heavens to which the rest bear relation as to their centres.

That the centres and bases which are like the stars of the heavens are very numerous in every Heaven... Thus all Spirits and all Angels are, in particular, the centres of influxes... Man, in like manner, is a centre of influxes, corresponding. SE 3033.
The Society thus manifested itself, when yet there was one who was as the centre to all the rest, and to whom the rest were referred in the order in which they were in the Society.
Everyone (in the Spiritual World) is as it were a certain centre, according to a stupendous form, from the Lord.
Every man is in his own reigning love, and thus as it were in the centre... Also all Angels and all Spirits are centres, for the heavenly form is from continuous centres.

All the least things of the body turn themselves to the common centre of our world, which is called the centre of gravity... But this centre of gravity is only the centre of gravity in nature; but in the Spiritual World the centre of gravity is different, this is determined with a man by the love in which he is, downwards if he has infernal love, and upwards if he has heavenly love...
